Q00293_TheHiddenVeins/30539-01.html.text: Priestess of the Earth Chichirin: I heard from Filaur of the Gray Pillar. You are trying to recover some old Maps, right? I used to be an apprentice for the cartography guild before becoming a seer. I helped Master Diana recover the Map that shows the sites of the ancient giants.

links.text: Ask her to recover the Map

Q00464_Oath/30539-01.html.text: Priestess of the Earth Chichirin: What can I do for you?

links.text: Say that you came to give her this book

Q00293_TheHiddenVeins/30539-02.html.text: Priestess of the Earth Chichirin: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough pieces of the torn Map. Look here. You don't have this part. See, just there? I think I need four pieces of the torn Map to make a complete Map.

Q00464_Oath/30539-02.html.text: Earth Priestess Chichirin: Oh, this book is...?! ...Where did you find this? I thought I lost it a long time ago. How did you find this book? Wow, you have an amazing talent. This book reminds me of the days in my youth. Thank you so much!! May blessing of Earth Goddess be upon you!! Karna Mapra!!
